rows.stated:
SIDE-spinor · Spinor.lean
  =========================

  The Spinor / Information IDENTIFICATION of σ = 1/2.

  Checkpoint 1.2-C in the alternative-proof-paths census
  (PATHS_TO_THE_CRITICAL_LINE). An IDENTIFICATION kernel — it
  verifies that the phase-invariant Hermitian observable M = vv†
  collapses its quarter-twist orbit {v, iv, −v, −iv} to a single
  fixed point only at the centered origin w = 0, i.e. σ = 1/2.
  It does NOT claim the Hilbert–Pólya spectral realization, nor
  prove RH on its own.

  Source: Paper 020 (Information Structure); IDENTITY_SUBSPACE_PAPER;
  THE_SPINOR_CALIBRATION; THE_FINDINGS (the dark 6/7, the 2 phase bits).
  v has |vₙ|² = |n| over n ∈ {−3,…,3}; ‖v‖² = 12; M = vv† spectrum
  {0⁶, 12}; aperture 1/7; T² = −I (720° return).
rows.licensed: The head says the file verifies that the Hermitian observable M = vv† collapses its quarter-twist orbit {v, iv, -v, -iv} to a fixed point only at w = 0, i.e. sigma = 1/2, and lists the spectrum {0^6, 12}. No declaration defines v as a vector, M, its spectrum or an orbit of v. The file compiles a list sum (12), 1 + 6 = 7 and 1/7, normSq I = 1, I^2 = -1, I^4 = 1, (I*w = w iff w = 0) for complex w, and (sigma = 1/2 iff sigma - 1/2 = 0) for real sigma, and nothing links w to s or sigma.
rows.action: RE-CUT: An IDENTIFICATION kernel: it verifies the arithmetic of the identification (the |n| list sums to 12, 1 + 6 = 7 and aperture 1/7, |i|^2 = 1, i^2 = -1 and i^4 = 1, and multiplication by i on C fixes only 0) and the real identity sigma = 1/2 iff sigma - 1/2 = 0; the observable M = vv†, its spectrum {0^6, 12} and the reading of w as s - 1/2 are the source papers' content, not compiled here.

rows.licensed: spectral_volume: the list [3,2,1,0,1,2,3] of |v_n|^2 = |n| sums to 12, as the section says.
aperture_decomp (1 + 6 = 7) and aperture (1/7) are compiled over the defined dimensions, as stated.

rows.stated:
## T3 — phase-invariance enabler: |i|² = 1

M = vv† is invariant under v ↦ iv because (iv)(iv)† = (i · conj i)·vv†
and i · conj i = |i|² = 1.
rows.licensed: phase_unit compiles normSq I = 1; the invariance of vv† under v to iv is offered as the elementary reason it enables, and it is true (rule 3).
spinor_sq (I^2 = -1) and spinor_order_four (I^4 = 1) carry the stated signature and its fourfold return.

rows.stated:
## T5 — orbit collapse: the identification

The quarter-twist w ↦ iw fixes only w = 0 (since i ≠ 1). In the
centered coordinate w = s − 1/2, w = 0 is σ = 1/2.
rows.licensed: The first sentence matches orbit_collapse_iff (I*w = w iff w = 0 for complex w). The second sentence states an equivalence that holds in one direction only: with complex w = s - 1/2, w = 0 is the single point s = 1/2 (sigma = 1/2 and t = 0). It implies sigma = 1/2 but is not the line sigma = 1/2. The kernel's only sigma link (half_iff_centered_zero, :75) is about a real sigma and never connects to w.
rows.action: RE-CUT: The quarter-twist w ↦ iw fixes only w = 0 (since i ≠ 1). In the centered coordinate w = s − 1/2, w = 0 is the point s = 1/2, which lies on σ = 1/2; the kernel does not connect w to σ.

rows.licensed: half_iff_centered_zero (sigma : R): sigma = 1/2 iff sigma - 1/2 = 0, exactly the stated link.

rows.stated:
SIDE-spinor · SpinorLeg.lean
  ============================

  The Spinor Leg — the metaplectic quarter-twist route to −1.

  W-REVIEWER-LENS: the completion of THE_SUBSTRATE.md §(ii).4's one open item.

  The calibration constant −1 has TWO disjoint derivations:

  • Route A (arithmetic / Frobenius; `SIDE-spinor-calibration/FrobeniusCalibration.lean`,
    vanilla Lean 4 / Int, no Mathlib): −1 = ‖v‖²·ζ(−1) = 12·(−1/12) = −g(2,3), through
    the {2,3}-smooth fiber norm ‖v‖² = 12 and ζ(−1) = −1/12.

  • Route B (this file, metaplectic / quarter-twist; Mathlib / ℂ): −1 = W⁴ = T², where
    W is the order-8 metaplectic lift of S (W⁴ = −Id, the cocycle) and T = W² is the
    quarter-twist, acting on the weight-½ spinor line as multiplication by i.

  The two routes share no nontrivial lemma: Route A never touches ℂ or the twist; Route B
  never touches g, ‖v‖², or ζ. In each, −1 is DERIVED, not typed (salt-checked).
rows.licensed: The head says Route B is the metaplectic route, with W the order-8 metaplectic lift of S (W^4 = -Id, the cocycle), and that -1 is "salt-checked". The file defines T := Complex.I and compiles i^2 = -1, i^4 = 1, (W^2 = i implies W^4 = -1) for complex W, and the witness (1+i)/sqrt 2. No declaration mentions S, a matrix, -Id or the metaplectic group. No salt-check file exists at the commit: git grep salt hits only :20, and the tree holds AxiomCheck.lean and SpinorLegAxioms.lean only. Route A's file does carry -g(2,3) = -1 and normSq = 12; zeta(-1) = -1/12 is classical.
rows.action: RE-CUT: Route B (this file; Mathlib / ℂ): with the quarter-twist read as T = i on the weight-½ spinor line, the file derives T² = −1 from i² = −1, and W⁴ = −1 for any complex W with W² = T, witnessed by ζ₈ = (1+i)/√2; the metaplectic lift of S and W⁴ = −Id are the reading, not compiled, and no salt-check is carried in the repository.
generated_findings: D5: a claim about Mathlib at the pin ('no Mathlib'), read by hand against Mathlib at the pin

rows.stated:
The quarter-twist T = W² (metaplectic, order 4) acts on the weight-½ spinor line as
    multiplication by i.
rows.licensed: The def T := Complex.I is multiplication by i, as the docstring says; the metaplectic name is the def's stated reading.

rows.stated:
The spinor signature: the quarter-twist squared is −1 — the metaplectic cocycle value
    W⁴ = −Id read on the spinor line. DERIVED (i² = −1), not stipulated.
rows.licensed: spinor_signature: T^2 = -1 by Complex.I_sq, and the docstring itself names the derivation (i^2 = -1).

rows.stated:
The metaplectic cocycle: any order-8 lift W with W² = T (the quarter-twist) satisfies
    W⁴ = −1. So −1 is the fourth power of the metaplectic generator — the cocycle value.
rows.licensed: metaplectic_cocycle: for every complex W with W^2 = T, W^4 = -1. Any such W has order 8 (elementary), so "any order-8 lift with W^2 = T" is exactly the statement.

rows.stated: A concrete order-8 witness: the primitive 8th root ζ₈ = (1+i)/√2 squares to i = T.
rows.licensed: zeta8_sq_eq_T: ((1+i)/sqrt 2)^2 = T; (1+i)/sqrt 2 is a primitive 8th root of unity (elementary).

rows.stated:
The concrete witness realizes the cocycle: ζ₈⁴ = −1. The quarter-twist is realized,
    not assumed.
rows.licensed: zeta8_pow_four: zeta8^4 = -1 via metaplectic_cocycle applied to the concrete witness, as stated.

rows.stated:
The spinor leg, packaged: the metaplectic route DERIVES −1 both as the quarter-twist
    signature T² and as the fourth power ζ₈⁴ of a concrete order-8 element — the same −1
    the arithmetic route lands, through disjoint machinery.
rows.licensed: spinor_leg_derives_neg_one is the conjunction T^2 = -1 and zeta8^4 = -1. The Route A file is vanilla Int with no shared import, so "disjoint machinery" holds at the file level.
